en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a waterway with a steamship passing under or near a large, raised railway bascule bridge. The bridge's steel structure dominates the right side, with railway tracks leading to it, while the left side shows the opposite bank and a low bridge or pier. The image has a vintage photographic style and scalloped postcard edges. At the bottom, a caption in Swedish identifies the scene.
